channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why have India’s Gen Z protesters called for a march to parliament?
item.description: After a prominent activist on hunger strike is forcibly removed, organisers announce a march to parliament.

item.title: Iranians suffer from power blackouts during war and heatwave
item.description: Collapsing grid, battered by military strikes and chronic underinvestment, leaves Iranians sweltering in the dark.

item.title: US launches new Iran strikes after two soldiers killed: What’s the latest?
item.description: US strikes target Iran's IRGC after two of its soldiers were killed in Jordan, as Tehran attacks Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Russia launches largest ballistic missile attack on Kyiv since start of war
item.description: Ukraine is particularly vulnerable to ballistic missile attacks due to a shortage of Patriot air defence munitions.

item.title: US bombs Iran for eighth-straight night
item.description: The US has launched a new wave of strikes on Iran after two American soldiers were killed by Iranian strikes in Jordan.

item.title: Moment Iranian missiles hit airbase in Jordan killing US soldiers
item.description: A video captures the moment an Iranian missile struck Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Airbase, killing two US service members.

item.title: US and Iran trade fire after two US soldiers killed in Jordan
item.description: Kuwait says an electricity and water plant is on fire after the second such attack in two days. Iran says US strikes hit an under-construction nuclear power plant.

item.title: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Ukrainian cities
item.description: Five people are killed and at least 35 injured as Ukraine's two largest cities are targeted, as Kyiv continues its own assault on Russian infrastructure.

item.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of tourist deaths linked to methanol
item.description: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

item.title: What this desert city can teach the world about tackling heat deaths
item.description: Maricopa County in Arizona has some of the hottest temperatures, but it has reduced the number of heat-related deaths.
